edges.effect_quant: The strongest quantitative studies point in a protective direction, but the pooled magnitude varies across populations and methods.
edges.mechanism: Carbamazepine stabilizes hyperexcitable sodium channels, which is well matched to the paroxysmal firing that drives trigeminal neuralgia pain.
edges.summary: For trigeminal neuralgia, the most useful starting point is the 2025 Yang meta analysis in Comb Chem High Throughput Screen. It found that carbamazepine tracks with lower risk or better outcomes, and the follow-on evidence is broadly consistent even when absolute benefit or harm is modest.
edges.caveats: Healthier-user bias, screening intensity, and baseline risk can all inflate apparent benefit in observational work, so the magnitude should be read conservatively.
